name: Brigade Icon
config: 3, 4 & 5 bed residences, including duplexes and penthouses
description: A mixed-use development of more than five acres on Mount Road, with about 200 residences in a G+38 tower alongside retail and offices. The tower has a copper-tinged facade and sits 100 m from Thousand Lights Metro.
curation: About 200 homes in a single tower on Anna Salai
Part of a residential, retail, and office development
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
photoDescription: Residential tower and office block at dusk, from above
